real_qa.q: Why should retirement investment strategy differ from working years investment strategy?
real_qa.r: When you are still working, you receive a regular paycheck every week, two weeks, twice a month, or monthly. Once you retire and walk out that door, you are in the dark when it comes to paychecks. Your investments need to transition to provide guaranteed income through annuities, pensions, or Social Security to ensure you have secure income for life rather than bouncing around like Space Mountain in the dark.

real_qa.q: What is the role of annuities in providing guaranteed retirement income?
real_qa.r: Annuities are the only vehicle that pays guaranteed income guaranteed by the insurance company, ensuring a payout for the rest of your life. If you are married, you can structure it to pay out for both of your lives. Major firms are pushing Congress to put annuities into 401ks because no other vehicle provides this guaranteed lifetime income benefit.

real_qa.q: What is the Dumbo investment approach for successful long-term wealth building?
real_qa.r: The Dumbo approach has four key principles: live on less than what you make, regularly put money in the market over time, start early, and stay the course during market downturns instead of pulling out at the bottom and missing the bounce and upswing. This boring but classic strategy has made many people very successful investors without doing anything exciting.
